series.title: NEPA DON TAKE LIGHT!
hooks: POV: NEPA takes light in the middle of the party
When the light goes and the generator has no fuel
Would you call the electrician or find fuel first?
beats: Blackout! Aunty Kemi: "NEPA don take light again!"
Player picks CALL THE ELECTRICIAN → "Na NEPA cut am, no be wire!"
Find fuel at Iya Bisi's kiosk, pour it in
Pull the rope 3 times → VROOOM, lights back, everybody dances
series.question: What would YOU do first? 👇

series.title: When Your Nigerian Neighbour Refuses to Pay
